content.text: The pad header is dropped in normalization, so the wire shrank — my test needs the growth to come from the From rewrite alone (the exact scenario the protocol calls out). Rewriting:

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
t = open("tmp/tests6.py").read()
old = t[t.index("# ---- wire growth"):t.index("# ---- folded values")]
new = '''# ---- wire growth: hop1 raw exactly at limit accepts, hop2 grown wire -> syntax ----
ident = "sip:" + "n" * 240 + "@" + "m" * 6 + ".test"   # 256 chars
assert len(ident) == 256, len(ident)
b = batch([{}],
          directory={ident: ["tel:+1"]},
          accounts={"sk": {"primary": ident, "allow": []}},
          gateways={"edge": {"local_domains": ["mmmmmm.test"], "peers": {}}})
# raw at exactly 32768 with a short From alias; normalization rewrites From
# to the 256-char canonical identity, so the forwarded wire grows past the limit
def mkraw(n):
    lines = ["MESSAGE sip:inbox@relay.test SIP/2.0",
             "From: <tel:+1>;tag=q7",
             "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>",
             "Call-ID: sample-73",
             "CSeq: 9 MESSAGE",
             "Content-Type: text/plain"]
    head = "\\r\\n".join(lines)
    body = "b" * (n - len(head) - len("Content-Length: 00000") - 4 - 5)
    cl = "Content-Length: %d" % len(body)
    raw = head + "\\r\\n" + cl + "\\r\\n\\r\\n" + body
    assert len(raw) == n, (len(raw), n)
    return raw
raw = mkraw(32768)
b["jobs"] = [
    {"gateway": "edge", "ingress": {"kind": "local", "subject": "sk"}, "trusted_out": True, "raw": raw},
    {"gateway": "edge", "ingress": {"kind": "local", "subject": "sk"}, "trusted_out": True, "source": 0},
]
res = run(b)
check("grown wire hop1 ok", res[0]["status"], "accept")
check("grown wire len > 32768", len(res[0]["wire"]) > 32768, True)
check("grown wire hop2 syntax", res[1], rej("syntax"))

'''
t = t.replace(old, new)
open("tmp/tests6.py","w").write(t)
PYEOF
python3 tmp/tests6.py 2>&1 | tail -5
